changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwbillingledger AS SELECT bl.id, bl.ledger_number, bl.transaction_group_id, bl.correlation_id, bl.idempotency_key, bl.patient_id, bl.encounter_id, bl.wallet_id, bl.payment_id, bl.payment_transaction_id, bl.charge_id, bl.charge_line_id, bl.charge_responsibility_id, bl.reservation_id, bl.allocation_id, bl.debit_account_id, bl.debit_transaction_id, bl.refund_id, bl.transaction_type, bl.ledger_scope, bl.amount, bl.currency, bl.available_change, bl.reserved_change, bl.consumed_change, bl.refunded_change, bl.debit_balance_change, bl.allocated_change, bl.outstanding_change, bl.wallet_available_before, bl.wallet_available_after, bl.wallet_reserved_before, bl.wallet_reserved_after, bl.debit_balance_before, bl.debit_balance_after, bl.responsibility_outstanding_before, bl.responsibility_outstanding_after, bl.entry_direction, bl.entry_category, bl.reversed_ledger_id, bl.reference_type, bl.reference_id, bl.reference_number, bl.description, bl.reason, bl.transaction_date, bl.source_channel, bl.created_by, bl.created_date, bl.last_modified_by, bl.last_modified_date FROM public.billing_ledger bl;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwbillingledger TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwbillingledger FROM report_user;
